# Alamin Pramanik — Frontend Developer

> Alamin Pramanik — frontend developer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and design systems.

## About

Alamin Pramanik is a frontend developer with 3+ years of experience building React and Next.js interfaces for multi-tenant SaaS. Currently owns the frontend of RepairCMS at Candy Melon Software GmbH (Austria), serving 1,100+ repair and service businesses in production.

Expertise: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Tailwind CSS, SCSS, Framer Motion, Figma, design systems, accessibility (WCAG), Core Web Vitals, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB, AWS.

## Projects

- [RepairCMS](https://repaircms.com) — Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS for repair/service businesses. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS.
- [RepairCMS B2B](https://b2b.repaircms.com) — Business console for repair/service businesses: schema-driven forms, KPI dashboard, barcode/QR, PDF quotes, four-language i18n.
- [RepairCMS Customer Portal](https://tracking.repaircms.com) — Customer-facing portal for real-time repair status, booking, and SEPA QR payments.
- [Al Jaami Technologies](https://www.aljaami.co.uk) — SEO-focused Next.js marketing site for a full-service IT agency.

## Services

- Frontend Application Development — React & Next.js apps, design systems, component architecture
- Design Systems & UI Engineering — Figma-to-code, responsive & mobile-first, accessible interfaces
- Performance & SEO Engineering — Core Web Vitals, image/bundle optimization, technical SEO
